code: sim_re <- function(N = 120, J = 4, ngrp = 8, sigma_b = 0.6, seed = 11) {   set.seed(seed)   grp <- rep(seq_len(ngrp), length.out = N)   b   <- rnorm(ngrp, sd = sigma_b)   dat <- data.frame(x1 = rnorm(N), g = factor(grp))   eta <- as.numeric(model.matrix(~ x1, dat) %*% c(0.6, 0.4)) + b[grp]   Nlat <- rpois(N, exp(eta))   y <- matrix(NA_integer_, N, J)   for (i in seq_len(N)) y[i, ] <- rbinom(J, Nlat[i], plogis(0))   list(y = y, data = dat, b = b) } sr <- sim_re() fr <- tobs(   ~ x1 + (1 | g),   data      = sr$data,   family    = abun(),   detection = ~ 1,   y         = sr$y,   method    = "laplace",   control   = list(n.quad = 5, verbose = FALSE) ) coef(fr, arm = "lambda") sig_name <- grep("^sigma_g", names(fr$means), value = TRUE) c(estimate = fr$means[[sig_name]], truth = 0.6) round(vcov(fr), 4) re <- ranef(fr) re library(ggplot2) re$truth <- sr$b[as.integer(re$level)] ggplot(re, aes(truth, estimate)) +   geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "steelblue", linewidth = 1) +   geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = estimate - std.error, ymax = estimate + std.error),                 width = 0, colour = "grey50") +   geom_point(size = 2) +   labs(x = "true group effect", y = "estimated BLUP") +   theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent"),         plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "transparent"))

code: grid_adj <- function(side) {   ng <- side * side   co <- expand.grid(x = seq_len(side), y = seq_len(side))   adj <- matrix(0L, ng, ng)   for (i in seq_len(ng)) for (j in seq_len(ng)) {     if (i != j && abs(co$x[i] - co$x[j]) + abs(co$y[i] - co$y[j]) == 1L)       adj[i, j] <- 1L   }   adj } adj <- grid_adj(6)        # 36 cells, one site per cell dim(adj) sim_spatial <- function(adj, b_lambda, b_p, J = 5, sd_phi = 0.6, seed = NULL) {   if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)   ng <- nrow(adj)   phi <- as.numeric(scale(rnorm(ng)))   for (rep in 1:3) {                       # smooth toward neighbours     pn <- phi     for (i in seq_len(ng)) {       nb <- which(adj[i, ] == 1L)       pn[i] <- 0.5 * phi[i] + 0.5 * mean(phi[nb])     }     phi <- pn   }   phi <- sd_phi * as.numeric(scale(phi)); phi <- phi - mean(phi)   x_ab <- rnorm(ng); x_det <- rnorm(ng)   lambda <- exp(b_lambda[1] + b_lambda[2] * x_ab + phi)   p <- plogis(b_p[1] + b_p[2] * x_det)   N <- rpois(ng, lambda)   y <- matrix(NA_integer_, ng, J)   for (i in seq_len(ng)) y[i, ] <- rbinom(J, N[i], p[i])   list(y = y, data = data.frame(abund_cov1 = x_ab, det_cov1 = x_det),        phi = phi) } ss <- sim_spatial(adj, b_lambda = c(log(5), 0.5), b_p = c(0.3, 0.4), seed = 42) fs <- suppressWarnings(tobs(   ~ abund_cov1 + bym2(graph = adj),   data      = ss$data,   family    = abun(),   detection = ~ det_cov1,   y         = ss$y,   method    = "nested_laplace",   control   = list(verbose = FALSE, max.iter = 50) )) coef(fs) c(field_cor = cor(fs$spatial_field, ss$phi),   method    = fs$method)

code: simulate_motivate <- function(n_plots        = 25L,                               n_years        = 4L,                               year_step      = 5,                               baseline_range = c(0, 10),                               intercept_occ  = -0.3,                               intercept_pos  = -1.5,                               beta_occ_btw   = -0.05,                               beta_occ_wtn   =  0.10,                               beta_pos_btw   = -0.02,                               beta_pos_wtn   =  0.05,                               alpha          = 1.0,                               sigma          = 0.6,                               rho            = 0.7,                               phi            = 30,                               sigma_pos_ln   = 0.4,                               positive       = c("beta", "lognormal"),                               seed           = NULL) {   positive <- match.arg(positive)   if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)    adj <- matrix(0L, n_plots, n_plots)   for (s in seq_len(n_plots)) {     if (s > 1L)       adj[s, s - 1L] <- 1L     if (s < n_plots)  adj[s, s + 1L] <- 1L   }    iid <- stats::rnorm(n_plots, 0, 1)   spa <- stats::rnorm(n_plots, 0, 1)   w_occ <- sigma * (sqrt(rho) * spa + sqrt(1 - rho) * iid)   w_pos <- alpha * w_occ    baselines <- stats::runif(n_plots, baseline_range[1], baseline_range[2])   plot_rows <- lapply(seq_len(n_plots), function(p) {     data.frame(       plot_id = factor(p, levels = seq_len(n_plots)),       year    = baselines[p] + (seq_len(n_years) - 1L) * year_step     )   })   dat <- do.call(rbind, plot_rows)    yr_btw <- stats::ave(dat$year, dat$plot_id, FUN = mean)   yr_wtn <- dat$year - yr_btw   yr_btw_c <- yr_btw - mean(c(baseline_range))    idx <- as.integer(dat$plot_id)   eta_occ <- intercept_occ +     beta_occ_btw * yr_btw_c + beta_occ_wtn * yr_wtn + w_occ[idx]   eta_pos <- intercept_pos +     beta_pos_btw * yr_btw_c + beta_pos_wtn * yr_wtn + w_pos[idx]    p_occ <- stats::plogis(eta_occ)   occur <- stats::rbinom(nrow(dat), 1L, p_occ)   y <- numeric(nrow(dat))   is_pos <- occur == 1L   if (positive == "beta") {     mu_pos <- stats::plogis(eta_pos)     y[is_pos] <- stats::rbeta(sum(is_pos),                               mu_pos[is_pos] * phi,                               (1 - mu_pos[is_pos]) * phi)   } else {     log_cov <- stats::rnorm(sum(is_pos), eta_pos[is_pos], sigma_pos_ln)     y[is_pos] <- exp(log_cov)   }   y <- pmin(pmax(y, 0), 1 - 1e-6)    list(     data  = dat,     y     = y,     adj   = adj,     truth = list(       beta_occ_btw = beta_occ_btw, beta_occ_wtn = beta_occ_wtn,       beta_pos_btw = beta_pos_btw, beta_pos_wtn = beta_pos_wtn,       alpha = alpha, sigma = sigma, rho = rho,       phi = phi, sigma_pos_ln = sigma_pos_ln,       positive = positive,       w_occ = w_occ, w_pos = w_pos,       baselines = baselines     )   ) }

code: side   <- 12L coords <- expand.grid(lon = seq_len(side), lat = seq_len(side)) N      <- nrow(coords)  adj <- matrix(0L, N, N)                     # rook adjacency on the grid for (i in seq_len(N)) for (j in seq_len(N)) {   if (i < j &&       abs(coords$lon[i] - coords$lon[j]) +       abs(coords$lat[i] - coords$lat[j]) == 1) {     adj[i, j] <- 1L; adj[j, i] <- 1L   } }  field <- 2.2 * sin(coords$lon / 2.2) + 2.2 * cos(coords$lat / 2.2) xg  <- rnorm(N) z   <- rbinom(N, 1, plogis(-0.2 + 0.5 * xg + field)) yg  <- matrix(0L, N, 7L) for (i in seq_len(N)) if (z[i] == 1L) yg[i, ] <- rbinom(7L, 1, 0.6) datg <- data.frame(x = xg) fit_ns <- tobs(~ x, data = datg, family = occu(),                detection = ~ 1, y = yg, method = "laplace",                control = list(verbose = FALSE)) fit_sp <- tobs(~ x + icar(graph = adj), data = datg, family = occu(),                detection = ~ 1, y = yg, method = "nested_laplace",                control = list(max.iter = 10L, verbose = FALSE)) mi_ns <- tulpa::moran_i(residuals(fit_ns)$occ, coords = coords,                         weights = "knn", k = 8) mi_sp <- tulpa::moran_i(residuals(fit_sp)$occ, coords = coords,                         weights = "knn", k = 8)  data.frame(   model    = c("non-spatial", "icar field"),   moran_I  = round(c(mi_ns$statistic, mi_sp$statistic), 3),   p_value  = signif(c(mi_ns$p.value, mi_sp$p.value), 2) ) vg <- tulpa::tulpa_variogram(residuals(fit_ns)$occ, coords = coords) plot(vg)

code: sim_re <- function(seed = 101, ng = 30L, per = 25L, J = 6L,                    b0 = 0.3, b1 = -0.6, sigma = 0.9, p = 0.45) {   set.seed(seed)   N <- ng * per   g <- rep(seq_len(ng), each = per)   x <- rnorm(N)   b_true <- rnorm(ng, 0, sigma)               # the per-cluster intercepts   z <- rbinom(N, 1, plogis(b0 + b1 * x + b_true[g]))   y <- matrix(0L, N, J)   for (i in seq_len(N)) y[i, ] <- rbinom(J, 1, z[i] * p)   list(y = y, d = data.frame(g = factor(g), x = x), b_true = b_true) }  s <- sim_re() str(s$d) fit <- tobs(   ~ x + (1 | g),   data      = s$d,   y         = s$y,   detection = ~ 1,   family    = occu(),   method    = "laplace",   control   = list(verbose = FALSE) ) coef(fit, arm = "psi") sig_name <- grep("^sigma_", names(fit$means), value = TRUE) sig_name c(estimate = fit$means[[sig_name]], truth = 0.9) re <- ranef(fit) head(re) nrow(re) plot(s$b_true, re$estimate, pch = 16, col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.5),      xlab = "true cluster effect", ylab = "estimated BLUP") abline(0, 1, col = "steelblue", lwd = 2) cor(s$b_true, re$estimate)

what: Laplace fit of the Royle (2004) N-mixture model — nmix_laplace
title: Laplace fit of the Royle (2004) N-mixture model — nmix_laplace
text: Maximum-likelihood fit (non-spatial, fixed effects ) Royle (2004) N-mixture model Poisson negative-binomial abundance mixing distribution: $$N_i \sim \mathrm{Poisson}(\lambda_i) \quad\text{}\quad       N_i \sim \mathrm{NegBin}(\mathrm{mean}=\lambda_i, \mathrm{size}=r),       \qquad y_{ij} | N_i \sim \mathrm{Binomial}(N_i, p_{ij}),$$ abundance linear predictor \(\log \lambda_i = X_\lambda^{()} \beta_\lambda\) detection linear predictor \(\mathrm{logit}\, p_{ij} = X_p^{(ij)} \beta_p\). NB uses neg_binomial_2 convention (size \(r\), variance \(\lambda + \lambda^2/r\)); Poisson \(r \\infty\) limit. Optimisation uses inner Newton \((\beta_\lambda, \beta_p)\) marginal observed Fisher information matrix curvature (complete-data Fisher fallback iterates observed-info Hessian PSD). mixture = "NB" dispersion \(\theta = \log r\) single global scalar, profiled outside beta-Newton block coordinate ascent analytic profile score. gradients Hessians analytical (numerical differentiation), fit converges small number iterations typically 20-50x faster unmarked::pcount()'s BFGS--numerical-derivatives path equivalent problems. non-spatial entry point; spatial nested-Laplace path places latent prior block abundance arm separate entry, added (see tulpa_nested_laplace_nmix() shipped).

title: Laplace fit of the Royle (2004) N-mixture model — nmix_laplace

title: Laplace fit of the Royle (2004) N-mixture model — nmix_laplace

X_lambda Numeric matrix [n_sites x p_lambda] abundance covariates. X_p Numeric matrix [n_obs x p_p] detection covariates (long form, row order matches y). mixture Abundance mixing distribution: "P" (Poisson, default) "NB" (negative binomial). "NB" extra dispersion parameter log_r (log NB size) estimated jointly reported standard error. beta_lambda_init Optional numeric [p_lambda] warm start. Defaults c(log(mean(y) + 0.1), 0, 0, ...). beta_p_init Optional numeric [p_p] warm start. Defaults zeros. log_r_init Optional scalar warm start log_r (NB ). Defaults method--moments estimate site count totals, clamped sensible range. r_max Upper bound NB size r (NB , default 1e5). optimiser pins log_r log(r_max) data consistent Poisson warning recommends mixture = "P". K_max Marginal-sum truncation. Defaults max(y) + 100 (matches unmarked::pcount), applied per site (see headroom). returned boundary_weight per site flags site whose posterior N puts non-trivial mass truncation; raise K_max weight exceeds ~1e-4. headroom Latent-N states summed site's max(y_i). code: # \donttest{ N <- 20L; J <- 3L adj <- matrix(0L, N, N) for (s in seq_len(N)) {   if (s > 1L) adj[s, s - 1L] <- 1L   if (s < N)  adj[s, s + 1L] <- 1L } sim <- simulate_occu_cover(N = N, J = J, positive = "lognormal",                            adj = adj, sigma = 0.7, alpha = 1, seed = 1L) long <- data.frame(site_id = rep(seq_len(N), each = J),                    visit = rep(seq_len(J), times = N),                    y = as.vector(t(sim$y)),                    det_cov1 = sim$visit_data$det_cov1,                    pos_cov1 = sim$visit_data$pos_cov1) od <- tobs_data(long, y = "y", site = "site_id", visit = "visit",                 det.covs = c("det_cov1", "pos_cov1")) y_pos <- sim$y_pos; y_pos[is.na(y_pos)] <- 0 # The dispersion goes on the outer grid so it is estimated and scored, and # the field-SD grid is pinned so both stages integrate the same support. ctl <- list(engine = "joint", verbose = FALSE,             sigma.grid   = exp(seq(log(0.15), log(2.0), length.out = 9)),             phi.grid.pos = exp(seq(log(0.20), log(0.90), length.out = 7))) fit <- tobs(~ occ_cov1 + icar(graph = adj),             data = cbind(data.frame(site_id = seq_len(N)), sim$data),             family = occu_cover("lognormal"),             detection = ~ det_cov1,             positive = ~ pos_cov1 + share(spatial()),             y = od$y, y_pos = y_pos, visits = od$det.covs,             method = "nested_laplace", control = ctl) sbc(fit, n.sim = 20L, controls = "narrow", fit.control = ctl) # }

code: # `occu()` takes the detection history as `y` and a ONE-sided state formula: # a two-sided formula would be resolved against a response the family does # not carry. `data` is site-level, `visits` visit-level. sim <- simulate_occu(N = 30, J = 3, seed = 1) d   <- transform(sim$data, cell = seq_len(30),                  lon = runif(30), lat = runif(30))  # A chain graph over the 30 cells: neighbours are consecutive indices. adj <- matrix(0L, 30, 30) adj[cbind(1:29, 2:30)] <- 1L adj[cbind(2:30, 1:29)] <- 1L  # \donttest{ ctrl <- list(verbose = FALSE, progress = FALSE)  # Areal field on occupancy fit <- tobs(~ occ_cov1 + icar(graph = adj, group_var = "cell"),             data = d, family = occu(), detection = ~ 1, y = sim$y,             method = "nested_laplace", control = ctrl) fit$spatial_field[1:5]  # Detection random effect by observer, who changes between visits obs <- simulate_occu(N = 60, J = 3, n_visit_groups = 4, seed = 1) fit_re <- tobs(~ occ_cov1, data = obs$data, family = occu(),                detection = ~ (1 | visit_group), y = obs$y,                visits = obs$visits, method = "laplace", control = ctrl) coef(fit_re)  # Areal spatially varying coefficient on `occ_cov2` fit_svc <- tobs(~ occ_cov2 + spatial(~ 1 + occ_cov2 || cell, graph = adj),                 data = d, family = occu(), detection = ~ 1, y = sim$y,                 method = "nested_laplace", control = ctrl) coef(fit_svc)  # Continuous NNGP varying coefficient on the `occ_cov2` slope fit_nngp <- tobs(~ occ_cov2 + spatial(lon, lat, model = "svc",                                       coefficients = "occ_cov2",                                       prior_range = c(0.5, 0.05)),                  data = d, family = occu(), detection = ~ 1, y = sim$y,                  method = "laplace", control = ctrl) coef(fit_nngp) # }

what: tulpaObs: Bayesian Occupancy, Abundance and Detection Models via 'tulpa' — tulpaObs-package
title: tulpaObs: Bayesian Occupancy, Abundance and Detection Models via 'tulpa' — tulpaObs-package
text: Fits Bayesian models species observed imperfect detection: single-season dynamic site occupancy (MacKenzie et al. (2002) doi:10.1890/0012-9658(2002)083[2248:ESORWD]2.0.CO;2 ), N-mixture abundance replicated counts (Royle (2004) doi:10.1111/j.0006-341X.2004.00142.x ), distance sampling, removal double-observer counts, false-positive time--detection occupancy, integrated models combining several data sources, multi-species joint species distribution models, hurdle model vegetation cover. Linear predictors take fixed, random, spatial temporal effects. model supplies observation likelihood 'tulpa' engine, fits Laplace approximation, nested Laplace integration hyperparameters, Hamiltonian Monte Carlo -U-Turn Sampler (NUTS) using automatic differentiation. Simulation, prediction diagnostic functions (posterior predictive checks, leave-one-cross-validation, simulation-based calibration) accompany model.

title: Within / between (Mundlak) decomposition for longitudinal data — within_between
text: <var><suffix[1]> - per-group mean var (-group component, constant within group), <var><suffix[2]> - var - <var><suffix[1]> (within-group deviation, summing zero within group). decomposition exact: data[[var]] == data[[btw]] + data[[wtn]]. Including columns regression (~ x_btw + x_wtn) separates cross-group association within-group association without imposing coefficient (random-effects assumption). Typical use MOTIVATE cover-resurvey workflow:   year_wtn carries within-plot temporal trend; year_btw absorbs across-plot timing heterogeneity (older versus newer baseline plots).
code: plots <- within_between(plots, group = "plot_id", vars = "year") fit   <- tobs(~ year_btw + year_wtn + bym2(graph = adj), data = plots,               family = cover("beta"), y = plots$cover,               method = "nested_laplace")
